settings.rule_line: Keep it kind. No real names, nothing that could identify anyone. Replies go live straight away.

settings.heading: Start a talk
settings.sub: Share your perspective. Small moments. Open conversations.
settings.kindness: Keep it kind. Leave out names and identifying details.

settings.heading: House rules
settings.rule_2: No real names, no handles, no screenshots, nothing that could identify anyone.
settings.rule_3: No hate, harassment or bullying. No selling, no links.
settings.rule_4: Your alias is the only name anyone sees. Your email stays private.
settings.moderation: Replies go live straight away. We read them, and we take down anything that breaks these rules.
settings.report: Spotted something that breaks the rules? Email us at {email} with the link.
settings.support: If a talk gets heavy, you don’t have to carry it alone. Call Tele-MANAS, India’s free 24×7 mental health helpline, on 14416 or 1800-891-4416.
